description: The IMUSA Espresso/Capuccino Maker brews up to 4 servings of aromatic, fresh espresso. Feel the coffeehouse experience with the variable steam control that allows you to froth milk and create delicious cappuccinos, macchiatos and lattes in the comfort of your own home. The espresso and cappuccino maker features a removable drip tray for easy clean up, and a temperature gauge for measuring the hot brewed coffee.
